about_the_game:
An all new heroine type, the "Motherly and Nurturing Woman"(A.K.A. Nurturing) makes her appearance in Custom Order Maid 3D2! 

This DLC lets you hire a "Nurturing" maid just as you would a "Muku," "Majime," or "Rindere" maid!

～Who is this Motherly and Nurturing Woman?～

Warm, gentle, and maternal. Always wearing a soft smile. She doesn't intend to have this effect, but her personality tends to make guys needy and dependent on her. Whenever Master's having even the slightest bit of trouble, she races to his aid. She's always welcoming and open toward him, and in love, she likes to take care of her partner. Her partner's happiness is her happiness, so she's always looking to help, comfort, and nurture.

• You can enjoy watching your Nurturing maid train, speak with others, and work in the Empire Club!

• Playable events are available before becoming a lover with your Nurturing maid, such as a love story, and events where she interacts with other maids!

content_descriptors.notes:

If you are not yet 18+ or if you are accessing from any country or located where adult material is specifically prohibited by law, do not play this game.
